description: Windows research watchdog wrapper using GPT Researcher with configurable Ollama inference, nomic embeddings, SearXNG search, Playwright browsing, Trafilatura or Crawl4AI extraction, and optional Qdrant memory.

tools.name: research
tools.documentation: Research, Description: Runs a GPT Researcher deep-research task, Command - research:TOPIC, Example - research:Compare local-first AI research stacks

questions.name: GPT_RESEARCHER_LLM_MODEL
questions.label: Ollama LLM model
questions.help: Model tag to use through the configured Ollama server. The wrapper maps it to FAST_LLM, SMART_LLM, and STRATEGIC_LLM.

questions.name: GPT_RESEARCHER_OLLAMA_BASE_URL
questions.label: Ollama base URL
questions.help: May point to this Windows device or to another machine on LAN/Tailscale.

questions.name: GPT_RESEARCHER_QDRANT_URL
questions.label: Qdrant URL
questions.help: Optional. Set when a long-running research worker should remember sources in Qdrant.
